subject.title: Virtualize and harden native chat timeline

question: Should native chat replace the established FunctionalUI `VirtualVStack` implementation with the new generic `NativeElement` and `VirtualizedChatView` architecture?
rationale: Both implementations virtualize the same production timeline, and source review cannot determine whether maintainers want a second generic rendering boundary or prefer hardening the recently merged supported primitive.

options.title: Harden the existing path
options.body: Port the useful scroll and permission fixes onto `VirtualVStack` and avoid adding a parallel native-host architecture.

options.title: Approve the native replacement
options.body: Adopt `VirtualizedChatView` as the single timeline owner, document why `VirtualVStack` is insufficient, and remove or deprecate the superseded path with focused proof.

recommendation.title: Harden the existing path
recommendation.body: Port the useful scroll and permission fixes onto `VirtualVStack` and avoid adding a parallel native-host architecture.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the active reviewer and a recent owner of both the timeline and native UI proof surface.
